$Comment: The Flaming Horseman's Breastplate, one of the six pieces of the Flaming Hallowed set the Horseman's Hoard can pay, and the only one that pays on the hard ride alone (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json): the stronger twin of the plain Horseman's Breastplate. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json) and of the Flaming Hallowed set (Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json). Its model is the collar chest the Horseman wears himself (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/) in its gold texture, where the plain breastplate is the chest without the collar; its icon is drawn from that model by tools/derive_art.py. Its armour is the game's ancient steel breastplate's numbers (the same Physical and Projectile resistance and Health), with its recipe left out (it is never crafted) and twice that piece's durability (150). On top of that it wards off Fire (DamageResistance.Fire, the Burning Jack Helm's shape, 0.10 is 10%) and raises DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 8% harder with it on. Light is the hotter glow of the Burning Jack Helm. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
